record.question: Under Rule 21 of GFR 2017, apart from observing financial propriety personally, every officer incurring or authorizing expenditure is also required to:
options: ensure that expenditure is sanctioned only after audit concurrence
verify that the expenditure is included in the annual procurement plan
obtain approval of the Finance Ministry for every item of non-recurring expenditure
enforce financial order, strict economy and observance of relevant financial rules by his own office and subordinate disbursing officers
